question.text: A block of mass ' $\mathrm{m}$ ' is connected to another block of mass ' $\mathrm{M}$ ' by a spring (massless) of spring constant ' $\mathrm{k}$ '. The blocks are kept on a smooth horizontal plane. Initially the blocks are at rest and the spring is unstretched. Then a constant force '$\mathrm{F}$' starts acting on the block of mass '$\mathrm{M}$' to pull it. Find the force on the block of mass '$\mathrm{m}$'
